tools.name: calculate_pue
tools.description: Calculate Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) for a data centre or server room. Returns PUE score, efficiency rating, annual cost estimate, and engineering recommendations.

it_load_kw.description: IT equipment power draw in kW. Example: 500

cooling_kw.description: Total cooling system power in kW. Example: 200

ups_losses_kw.description: UPS and power distribution losses in kW. Example: 25

tools.name: check_nis2_readiness
tools.description: Assess NIS2 Directive (EU 2022/2555) compliance readiness. Returns compliance score (0-18), maturity level, estimated fine exposure, and prioritised remediation actions.

tools.name: assess_epbd_score
tools.description: Assess EU EPBD (2024) compliance. Returns compliance score, renovation cost estimate, deadline pressure, and priority retrofit measures.

building_type.description: e.g. office, residential, retail, school, hospital

heating_system.description: gas_boiler, heat_pump, district_heating, electric, oil_boiler, biomass

country.description: e.g. germany, france, netherlands, ireland, uk

tools.name: estimate_cooling_load
tools.description: Estimate cooling load using CIBSE Guide B2 / ASHRAE methodology. Returns required capacity, installed capacity with redundancy, system recommendation, and annual energy.

it_load_kw.description: Required for data_centre/server_room. Set 0 for others.

tools.name: check_uae_bim_compliance
tools.description: Check UAE BIM mandate applicability (Dubai Circular 196, Abu Dhabi DMT, Sharjah). Returns mandate status, compliance score, required LOD, and submission checklist.

tools.name: check_uae_cybersecurity
tools.description: Assess UAE cybersecurity regulatory compliance (NESA IAS, Dubai ISR, CBUAE, TDRA). Returns applicable framework, compliance score, critical gaps, and mandatory controls.

tools.name: check_grid_feasibility_uae
tools.description: Assess UAE grid connection feasibility (DEWA/ADDC/SEWA/FEWA). Returns feasibility score, connection timeline, recommended voltage, substation requirement, and next steps.

tools.name: get_technical_dd_quote
tools.description: Generate an indicative Technical Due Diligence (TDD) fee estimate. Returns preliminary and full DD fee ranges (GBP), turnaround days, and contact CTA.

building_type.description: office, data_centre, industrial, retail, residential, mixed_use, hotel, warehouse, healthcare

tools.name: calculate_carbon
tools.description: Calculate operational + embodied carbon and net-zero gap (CIBSE TM65 / RICS WLCA). Returns carbon intensity, benchmark, and prioritised reduction measures with payback.

building_type.description: office, residential, retail, industrial, hospital, warehouse, hotel

country.description: ISO-2: gb, de, fr, nl, es, pl, ro, it, ae, us

energy_kwh_year.description: Measured annual energy; 0 to use benchmark

tools.name: thermal_load
tools.description: Thermal Load Estimator for data centres / critical facilities. Returns total heat load, cooling capacity, units, airflow, chiller size, PUE estimate, power density, and a CRAC/CRAH/DLC/immersion comparison.

tools.name: roi_calculator
tools.description: Engineering ROI calculator. Returns current manual cost, annual saving, net benefit, ROI %, payback months, 3-year NPV and a verdict.

tools.name: building_carbon_footprint
tools.description: Building carbon footprint (Scope 1/2/3) with CRREM stranding check and embodied carbon. Returns per-scope tCO2e, intensity, CRREM compliance, net-zero gap and priority actions.

tools.name: building_readiness
tools.description: Building Readiness assessment for change-of-use / conversion. Returns a 0-100 readiness score, project complexity, four domain scores (structural, MEP, compliance, digital/BIM) with RAG, and recommendations.

tools.name: eurocode_beam_designer
tools.description: Preliminary Eurocode beam design (steel EC3 / composite / reinforced concrete EC2). Selects a section, computes ULS bending & shear utilisation, SLS deflection, and fire protection. Indicative, not a stamped design.

load_position.description: Point-load position as fraction of span 0-1 (default 0.5)

tools.name: eurocode_column_checker
tools.description: Eurocode axial column buckling check (steel EC3 6.3.1 flexural buckling / RC EC2 5.8 simplified). Returns Ncr, non-dimensional slenderness, reduction factor chi, NRd and utilisation. Indicative, not a stamped design.

section.description: Steel section key, e.g. UC203x203x46 (steel only)

width_mm.description: RC column width b (mm), concrete only

depth_mm.description: RC column depth h (mm), concrete only

tools.name: eu_cost_benchmarking
tools.description: Parametric construction cost benchmark across UK/EU/GCC by country, project type, specification, procurement, programme and BIM. Returns per-m2 and total cost ranges plus a cost breakdown. Indicative parametric estimate, validate against current cost indices.

tools.name: dgnb_bim_readiness
tools.description: DGNB certification pre-score and BIM (ISO 19650) maturity self-assessment from a 20-question checklist. Returns pre-score, achievable certification level, BIM level, domain breakdown and prioritised gaps. Not a formal DGNB audit.

answers.description: Map of question_id -> yes|partial|no. IDs: lca, materials, water, biodiversity, lcc, flexibility, value_stability, cert_budget, comfort, accessibility, wellbeing, satisfaction, bep, cde, competency, clash, integrated_team, commissioning, documentation, poe

tools.name: contractor_vetting
tools.description: NIS2 / EPBD contractor vetting score from a 12-question checklist across financial, technical, cyber (NIS2) and energy (EPBD) categories. Flags blocking (critical) failures and returns recommended additional checks. Not a formal due-diligence report.

answers.description: Map of question_id -> yes|no|unknown. IDs: registered, insurance, no_prosecutions, certifications, references, cvs, cyber_policy, incident_reporting, access_control, assessor_cert, energy_qual, reno_experience

tools.name: digital_renovation_passport
tools.description: EPBD-style staged digital renovation passport: 3-phase roadmap (quick wins, system upgrades, deep renovation) with cost ranges, energy savings and EPC trajectory from current EPC, floor area and heating type. Indicative.

tools.name: uk_planning_checker
tools.description: UK permitted-development (GPDO 2015, England) rules engine for extensions, loft conversions and change of use. Returns a verdict (likely_pd / requires_permission / complex), applicable PD class, conditions and flags (listed building, Article 4, conservation area, AONB). Indicative, verify with the LPA.

use_class.description: Existing use class (C3, C1, E, B2, B8, F1, F2, SG)

proposed_use.description: Proposed use class (change of use only); 'same' if unchanged

extension_depth_m.description: Rear extension depth (m), for extension proposals

tools.name: part_s_ev
tools.description: UK Approved Document S 2021 electric-vehicle charge-point requirement calculator for new build and major renovation, residential and non-residential. Returns required charge points, cable routes (1-in-5 for non-residential), minimum power and the applicable cost caps/exemptions. Indicative.

tools.name: part_o_overheating
tools.description: UK Approved Document O 2021 simplified-method overheating check for new residential: tests maximum glazing area (by orientation, risk zone, cross vs single aspect) and minimum free ventilation area. Returns pass/fail and points to CIBSE TM59 modelling if it fails. Indicative.

location_risk.description: high = listed London postcode districts (AD O Table C1)

tools.name: mees_checker
tools.description: England & Wales Minimum Energy Efficiency Standard (MEES) check for private rented property. Tests against the in-force EPC E minimum (domestic and non-domestic) and surfaces the PROPOSED (not yet law) EPC C / 2030 uplift as an advisory only. Returns compliance, can-let, cost cap and penalties.

tools.name: heatpump_heatloss
tools.description: Domestic whole-dwelling fabric + ventilation heat-loss estimate for heat pump sizing (BS EN 12831 / MCS), from floor area, storeys, age band, location and glazing. Returns design heat loss (kW), recommended heat pump output, indicative SCOP and annual demand. Typical U-values/SCOP, not measured.

tools.name: eed_datacentre_pack
tools.description: EU Energy Efficiency Directive data-centre reporting pack (Dir (EU) 2023/1791 Art.12 + Del. Reg (EU) 2024/1364). Determines reporting scope (IT power >= 500 kW) and computes the mandated KPIs PUE, WUE, ERF and REF. Note: the regulation mandates reporting, not target values.

water_input_m3.description: WIN: total water input (m3/yr), for WUE

renewable_energy_kwh.description: ERES-TOT renewable energy consumed, for REF

reused_heat_kwh.description: EREUSE waste heat reused, for ERF

tools.name: uae_climate_ghg
tools.description: UAE Scope 1 + Scope 2 GHG estimate from electricity and gas use, with emirate-specific grid emission factors (Dubai/Abu Dhabi/national) and the Federal Decree-Law No. 11 of 2024 mandatory-reporting context. Grid factors carry base-year/confidence caveats.

gas_m3.description: Annual natural gas (m3), alternative to gas_kwh

tools.name: sap_sbem_precheck
tools.description: UK SAP 10.3 / SBEM EPC precheck. Maps a known SAP rating (1-100) to its EPC band, and/or computes annual CO2 and primary energy from fuel consumption using validated SAP 10 fuel factors. The official EPC band is cost-based and needs a full SAP/RdSAP assessment.

sap_rating.description: Known SAP rating 1-100 (returns the EPC band)

annual_energy_kwh.description: Map fuel -> kWh/yr. Fuels: mains_gas, grid_electricity, heating_oil, lpg, wood_pellets, wood_logs, wood_chips, biomass_community
